verified_facts.text: The hotel is on a beachfront in Stone Town, a designated UNESCO Heritage site.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located along a pristine stretch of beachfront in Stone Town, a designated UNESCO Heritage site

verified_facts.text: Mambo Msiige is a historic structure built in the 17th century.
verified_facts.excerpt: Mambo Msiige, an historic structure built in the 17th century

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms feature four-poster canopy beds and traditional, hand-carved Zanzibari furnishings.
verified_facts.excerpt: feature plush, four-poster canopy beds and traditional, hand-carved Zanzibari furnishings

verified_facts.text: There is an Anantara Spa onsite.
verified_facts.excerpt: There’s an excellent Anantara Spa and a state-of-the-art fitness center onsite

verified_facts.text: The hotel has an oceanfront infinity pool that overlooks Stone Town beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: oceanfront infinity pool, which overlooks the entire expanse of Stone Town beach

verified_facts.text: Zamani Residence includes a Library and Veranda, a Living Room and a Dining Room with an outdoor terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Zamani Residence includes a Library and Veranda, a Living Room and a Dining Room with an outdoor terrace and a residential style kitchen.

verified_facts.text: All bar and dining areas have their own oceanfront terrace overlooking the beach and the Indian Ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: All bar and dining areas have their own oceanfront terrace overlooking the local beach and the Indian Ocean.

verified_facts.text: The Dining Room has the feel of a traditional Omani colonial home with views to the dhow harbours and Indian Ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dining Room has the warm, welcoming and opulent feel of a traditional Omani colonial home and lies at the heart of the Zamani Residence with stunning views to the dhow harbours and Indian Ocean.

verified_facts.text: The Pool Lounge specialises in local fish dishes alongside salads, sandwiches and snacks.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Pool Lounge, adjacent to the oceanfront infinity pool, specialises in local fish dishes alongside traditional western salads, sandwiches and snacks.

verified_facts.text: The Living Room offers signature cocktails amid statement chandeliers and plush seating.
verified_facts.excerpt: Vibrant accents, statement chandeliers and plush seating create a warm and sophisticated atmosphere, ideal for unwinding over a signature cocktail or beverage of your choice.

verified_facts.text: There is a fitness center onsite.
verified_facts.excerpt: There’s an excellent Anantara Spa and a state-of-the-art fitness center onsite

verified_facts.text: The hotel is on Shangani Street in Stone Town.
verified_facts.excerpt: Address Shangani Street, Stone Town Zanzibar 4255
